payload.notes: Real root cause: forwarding encoding mismatch. The frozen plan defines fwd 2'b01=EX/MEM and 2'b10=MEM/WB, and forwarding_unit already emits 2'b01 for EX/MEM and 2'b10 for MEM/WB. But ex_stage's mux was inverted: it selected ex_mem_alu_result on fwd==2'b10 and mem_wb_wdata on fwd==2'b01. So EX/MEM ALU results were taken from the stale MEM/WB value and vice versa, corrupting all dependent ALU/I-type/forward/load-store results and the ECALL path (halt timeout). Fix: correct ex_stage forwarding mux to select ex_mem_alu_result on fwd==2'b01 and mem_wb_wdata on fwd==2'b10, matching the plan and forwarding_unit. forwarding_unit.sv is returned unchanged (already correct) to keep the patch set explicit; ex_stage.sv is the file that actually changes.
